flags.name: --help
flags.description: Show this help message and exit

flags.name: --output
flags.description: Output file location, this will be the file the data will be written to on a successful cracked password. If no output location is specified, the default location will be the same filename with ".out" appended to the name.

flags.name: --threads
flags.description: Number of concurrent threads used to crack passwords with, increasing this number might lead to better performance. Default: 16

flags.name: --chunk-size
flags.description: Number of passwords loaded into memory per thread cycle. After each password of the chunk has been depleted a status update will be printed to the console with the attempted password. Default: 64

flags.name: --quiet
flags.description: Runs the program in "quiet mode", meaning no status updates or other output besides the cracked password will be echoed to the terminal. By default, all logging / error messages are printed to stderr (making piping to other processes easier).

flags.name: --version
flags.description: Print the current version number and exit.

flags.name: --verbose
flags.description: Runs the program in "verbose mode", this will print additional debugging information (include this output when submitting bug reports). Cannot be used in conjunction with the "--quiet" argument.
